description: ACTGOV Drinking Fountain Assets is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). This point dataset shows the locations of Drinking Fountains in the Australian Capital Territory. These assets are either owned or managed by City Services, City and Environment Directorate (CED) and Parks and Conservation Service, City and Environment Directorate (CED). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Geospatial Data Catalogue (ACTmapi). Its tags are asset, ced, community-facilities-and-assets, drinking-fountain, drinking-fountain-with-dog-bowl. It offers 11 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, gdb, geojson, gpkg. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
